answer: Echo-Timing Registration Gate. Each new identity must submit its first three actions with inter-arrival gaps drawn from a seeded schedule; the agent's clock drift is checked against a violet reference beacon, and a slow vine of prior traffic must connect each action to a distinct earlier timestamp. Sybils creating many identities in parallel cannot fake staggered timing without idling real compute per identity, so each fake costs sustained wall-clock delay plus a dedicated machine.
